name: Alpenblick
beschreibung: The Gasthof Alpenblick is located in the Tyrolean municipality of Schattwald, in the district of Reutte. This accommodation is quietly situated on the outskirts of town, offering views of the Allgäu and Lechtal Alps. The rooms feature bathrooms, toilets, satellite TV, and some with balconies. The restaurant serves regional dishes and international classics. The property includes a guest garden and a wellness area with a sauna and steam bath. Hiking and skiing tours can be started directly from the inn. The family-run business is open year-round.
